source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper identifies one ATT(g,t) with every valid comparison cohort, optimizes weights within that ATT's comparison-cohort vector, and proves its minimum variance within that weighted-average class.

The cited version proves a deterministic-weight stacked event-study CLT, includes covariance from shared comparison units, and gives a consistent unit-level influence-function variance estimator with Wald coverage.
The paper derives conditional-covariance efficient DiD/ES influence functions and efficient estimators under staggered DiD assumptions; its moment system has no DDD eligibility contrast.

The paper studies canonical two-period DDD, supplies panel identification under consistency, no anticipation, positivity, and conditional parallel-difference-in-trends, and develops cross-fitted semiparametric estimators.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Restrict the cohort and target-set definitions to g in {2,...,T}; then state the g=2 and |K|=1 reductions explicitly in the theorem text.

Replace the informal reuse graph by a labelled multigraph or incidence tensor that records score coordinate (k,c), residual-cell/time label, sign, omega, and the admissible covariance map; prove that this invariant is sufficient for the proposed uniform classification.

Add a worked nondegenerate three-cohort/two-event instance with an estimated strictly positive variance gap, and disclose Hsieh's cited Leventer (2025) working paper as unavailable theorem-text WIP pending source verification.

recommended_next_step: Revise the two well-posedness defects, add the labelled-graph specification and a strict-gap instance, then advance the repaired field-tier kernel to Stage 0.
